title: Knowledge-Guided LLM for Intent-Driven Service Orchestration in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial 6G Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.33007v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language service intents in integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) 6G networks can be incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent, making unconstrained LLM generation challenging for reliable network-facing orchestration. This paper proposes a knowledge-guided LLM framework that combines grammar-constrained semantic parsing with a knowledge-graph (KG)-driven clarification loop to produce validated, orchestration-ready service profiles across four representative service classes. On a 200-sample intent dataset, the framework achieves 89% classification accuracy and 95% policy validity with an average of 0.66 clarification turns per request. Compared with a Pure-LLM baseline, the proposed framework improves policy validity and contradiction detection while requiring fewer clarification turns, demonstrating the value of explicit knowledge-guided reasoning for robust intent processing in integrated TN/NTN 6G orchestration.

translated_title: 知识引导的大语言模型用于地面与非地面一体化6G网络中意图驱动的服务编排
translated_abstract: 自然语言形式的服务意图在地面与非地面（TN/NTN）一体化6G网络中可能存在不完整、含糊或不一致的问题，这使得无约束的大语言模型生成难以满足面向网络的可靠编排需求。本文提出了一种知识引导的大语言模型框架，将语法约束的语义解析与知识图谱（KG）驱动的澄清循环相结合，在四个代表性服务类别中生成经过验证的、可直接用于编排的服务配置。在一个包含200个样本的意图数据集上，该框架实现了89%的分类准确率和95%的策略有效性，每个请求平均仅需0.66轮澄清。与纯大语言模型基线相比，所提框架在提升策略有效性和矛盾检测能力的同时减少了澄清轮次，证明了显式知识引导推理对一体化TN/NTN 6G编排中鲁棒意图处理的价值。
tldr: 本文提出一种融合语法约束语义解析与知识图谱驱动澄清循环的知识引导大语言模型框架，在地面与非地面一体化6G网络中以更少的澄清轮次实现了89%的分类准确率和95%的策略有效性，显著优于纯LLM基线。
